Admission in Fellow Programme in Management:

G L Bajaj Institute of Management and Research. PGDM Institute, Greater Noida, offers The Fellow Programme in Management (FPM) which is approved by AICTE, New Delhi. This programme offers a rigorous academic and research platform in diverse areas of management, specially designed for academicians; students and professionals, driven by an inherent passion to impact business management.

This Fellow Programme in Management (non-residential) programme focuses on quality research through continuous mentoring process by senior academicians and professional with vast experience from diverse fields.

Offering Research opportunities in the following areas:

  • Business Communication
  • Corporate Social Responsibility
  • Decision Science
  • Economics
  • Entrepreneurship & Sustainability
  • Finance
  • IT & Data Analytics
  • Marketing
  • Organisational Behavior & Human Resource
  • Operations

Click the image for larger view:

Programme Highlights:

  • Comprehensive Research Process in domain area and in Research Methodology for a successsful career in academics.
  • Well defined structure and Multi-disciplinary approach allowing Research Scholars to choose the Research Topics of their area of interest.
  • Research Scholars can choose between full time positions (with Scholarships) and Part-Time positions according to their career needs.
  • Academic Collaborations for Research Gaps in the areas of Management Theory and Practices.
  • Research Grants for participaiton in Workshop/Seminar/Conference.

Admission Eligibility:

Selection in the FPM programme shall be on the basis of the following criteria:

  • Master's Degree or equivalent in Engineering and Technology/Management/Economics/Social Science/Biological Science/Pure Science/Commerce/Humanities with FIRST CLASS shall be considered for admission to Fellow Programme.
  • Those appearing for their final examination in the respective discipline can also apply. Such students if selected shall be provisionally admitted provided they complete all requirements in obtaining their Master's Degree before 30th September of the year of admission. The admission of these candidates shall remain provisional until they produce the mark sheet proving that they satisfy the eligibility criteria. The deadline for submitting the final year mark sheet is 31st December.

Admission Procedure:

  • Admission to the Fellow Programme shall normally be made once a year, coinciding with that of AICTE approved Post Graduate Diploma in Management or equivalent Degree/ Diploma.
  • Accordingly, the advertisement shall be made along with such Post Graduate Degree/ Diploma.
  • Submit an Online Application (Application Form given below)
  • Upload the attested copies of all the necessary Certificates and testimonials are to be attached with the applications.
  • Upload an abstract of about 5000 words on the area of research interest (tentative research proposal)
  • Interview will be taken by selection committee.
  • The decision of the Institution Selection Committee regarding admission shall be final. Communication shall be sent only to the selected candidates.
  • Submission of fee within one week by the selected candidates.

Selection Criteria:

Selection for the Fellow Programme in the Institutions approved by AICTE for the Fellow Programme shall be on the basis of the following criteria:

  • Academic qualifications and work experience.
  • Tentative research proposal and its presentation before the Selection Committee.
  • Personal Interview.

ABOUT THE PGDM PROGRAM:

The 2 year Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) (Approved by All India Council of Technical Education, Ministry of HRD, Government of India) is designed for a holistic development of students making them not only career oriented but also employable & corporate ready for various roles and responsibilities. The program enables students with strong conceptual skills to manage businesses in an integrated manner. Achieving academic excellence integrated with skill enhancement is the core focus of the Institute. Innovative pedagogy, Value based research Orientation & Academic Excellence are our cornerstones, where it is made sure that both the curriculum and the pedagogical methodologies are revised as per the requirement. GLBIMR PGDM Institute updates the curriculum and adds Innovative practices based on present requirements of the corporate sector, benchmarking against top B-Schools and insights from recent studies on the effectiveness of PGDM programs.

PGDM PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS:

  • > Tie-up with Internationally acclaimed Corporate Leaders as Adjunct Faculty Members
  • > Free Laptop to all PGDM/PGDM (General) students.
  • > Dual and Major/Minor Specialization
  • > Global Academic Exposure through International Exchange Programs
  • > International Excursion Trip as a part of the curriculum to Meritorious students.
  • > Scholarships to the meritorious students on the basis of MAT Composite Score, CAT / XAT percentile, CMAT ranking as well as on the basis of academic performance.
  • > A good placement record in various sectors such as E-Commerce, FMCG, Consumer Durables, BFSI, Manufacturing, Real Estate, and Hospitality, HR consulting, and more.
  • > Fees in easy Instalments
